name: Keystones

notes: The current party becomes a new generation of guardians rather than simple keepers.
Guardians are expected to actively develop and protect their assigned realms instead of merely hiding the keystones.
Each assigned party member now bears responsibility for protecting a keystone.
The keystones are powerful artifacts that require careful stewardship.
The lich continues to seek the keystones.

openQuestions: What new powers or responsibilities accompany becoming a keeper?
